title: News → AI summary → Telegram
description: Every morning: read the latest news, AI writes a 2-line Hinglish summary of each, sends to your Telegram.

title: Daily AI quote → Telegram
description: Every day at 7 AM the AI writes a fresh motivational quote and posts it to your Telegram chat or channel.

title: Webhook → AI reply (your own AI API)
description: Call http://localhost:5679/webhook/ask with {"message":"..."} and get an AI answer back. Use it from any app, website or bot.

title: AI caption + hashtags → Reel to Instagram + Telegram
description: At 6 PM daily: AI writes a caption with hashtags, then posts your Reel to Instagram and the same video to your Telegram channel.

title: New video in folder → YouTube (AI title + description)
description: Drop a video into the folder. AI writes title, description and tags, uploads to YouTube (private first), and pings you on Telegram.

title: Website down alert → Telegram
description: Checks your website every 5 minutes. If it is not OK (status ≠ 200), you get a Telegram alert.
